abcjs-basic-min.cjs is the unmodified dist/abcjs-basic-min.js from abcjs 6.7.0.
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/abcjs/-/abcjs-6.7.0.tgz
Project: https://github.com/paulrosen/abcjs
License: MIT; see abcjs-LICENSE.md alongside the bundle.
SHA256: b0cde4bc52bb33949181683a245005fff8a024a8c1f07ec6ce3222cd4bd72e51

The .cjs extension prevents ComfyUI from automatically importing this UMD bundle
as an extension module. preview.js loads it as a same-origin classic script.
